name: Oolong Tea
siboNotes: Plain oolong tea is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Avoid adding high FODMAP sweeteners or milk containing lactose.
preparationTips: Brew with hot water (185-205°F) for 3-5 minutes for optimal flavor
Can be steeped multiple times - each steeping reveals different flavor notes
Avoid adding honey, agave, or regular milk which contain FODMAPs
Use lactose-free milk or small amounts of hard cheese for creaminess if desired
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants, particularly polyphenols and catechins
Contains moderate caffeine (less than black tea, more than green tea)
May support metabolism and heart health
